description: AI Agents (inside one system): Use when the person asks for this in a system whose AI agent may change records: An email or text message sent to a contact from the person's own system, as part of the conversation with them. The contact receives it, and only the person can approve it. Give one item per record, at most 25. Nothing is written yet: the answer shows, per record, what it holds now and would hold after, plus a proposal id. Show it to the person, say so first when something would be sent to the people in their system, ask whether to go ahead, and only then call apply_proposal; when needsApproval is true, share the approve link instead. Not for reading (use search_records or get_record).

items.description: One object per record, at most 25.

email.description: Send to this address of the contact instead of their main one.

id.description: The id of the contact in the system.

send_at.description: When to send it, ISO 8601 in UTC; now when left out.

statement.description: True to attach the contact's account statement to an email, where the system keeps one.

type.description: The type of the record: a contact.

system.description: Which AI agent: the system's id from get_ai_agent_options, or the name of the system or its connection. Ask the person which AI agent they mean unless they named it in this conversation; never pick one yourself.

name: propose_send_message
title: Propose: Send a message
